Messages.Author: DPH
Messages.Body:
Quick question.

The Brujah Antitribu weapon, Sword of Justice can only be
brought into play by a Brujah Ant. as it has the clan symbol
on it. However, it also says on the card "the Brujah ant.
with this weapon...". Now does this mean that:

a. WotC have been over-zealous on their typewriters and is a
misprint, therefore it can be transferred as normal between
minions.

b. You never could transfer this sort of equipment between
minions. Having said this I can't think of any other clan
specific equipment...

c. Something completely different?

Peter

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
CLA...@leeds.ac.uk (DPH) writes:

>The Brujah Antitribu weapon, Sword of Justice can only be
>brought into play by a Brujah Ant. as it has the clan symbol
>on it. However, it also says on the card "the Brujah ant.
>with this weapon...". Now does this mean that:

>c. Something completely different?

It may be transferred, but only a BruAnt may use it to any effect.
Just as an Ally can posses Aaron's Feeding Razor, but will get no
use from it.

Messages.Body:

: It may be transferred, but only a BruAnt may use it to any effect.

: Just as an Ally can posses Aaron's Feeding Razor, but will get no
: use from it.

In case someone has trouble in seeing the utility of being able to
transfer what is, in effect, useless equipment, consider the following
(if convoluted) situation:

I've got a BruAnt out with a sword of justice, a Nos weenie, and
Heidelburg (or is it berg?).

the BruAnt is down to 0 blood. I've got another in my
uncontrolled region that's almost full. And I'm being rushed by a
combat monster. Well, before combat begins I use Heidelb*rg to
transfer the sword to the Nossie. The BruAnt then gets slaughtered...
but I don't lose the equipment. When my almost full BruAnt comes
into play, I use Heidelb*rg to give 'em the sword back. The Nossie
is just a place holder. :)

-spongy
